purpose: Neutral, public-evidence supplements given identically to every model; not reference grades or reviewer rationales

sfa-2ec299072ec589b5.claim: Bewilder says its mycological studio cultivates fungi, turning organic by-products into food, medicines and fungal materials; no coffee-ground acceptance quantity is stated.

sfa-5fb698b98e7fbd33.claim: MEOD states that its Mobile Gulley System grows vegetables using hydroponics without soil; its website also invites visitors to pick some mushrooms, so a blanket no-substrate assumption is not justified.

directory-79d8fd79dfa6be2.claim: NEA describes A1 Environment recovering spent coffee grounds for composite materials and compost; whether CoffeeBot can deliver additional grounds remains unconfirmed.

directory-17af2bb59a62580.claim: NParks lists City Garden Pte Ltd among accredited nurseries; accreditation does not prove acceptance of coffee grounds.

directory-7a0be8930f9fd2e.claim: NParks lists Nature Landscapes Pte Ltd (ST) among accredited nurseries; reuse capacity and willingness are not stated.

moe-horizonprimary.claim: Horizon Primary describes recycling and upcycling programmes including shirts, caps and cartons; the source does not establish an active coffee-ground receiving garden.

directory-23851aef1dcd60e.claim: KAF Resources describes its core work as EPDM rubber and playground/sports flooring materials; a coffee-ground filler experiment is not documented.

moe-holyinnocentsprimary.claim: Holy Innocents' Primary environmental science activities include learning in the school's science garden; collection approval is unverified.

directory-143752cbac03d92.claim: SMU describes Ento Industries using black soldier flies to process food waste and charging service fees for much intake; acceptance of separated coffee grounds and fees remain unknown.
